method: Extract actual chooser and destroyWebView Java methods; run in JDK 17 against explicit Android API test doubles. No WebView/device runtime is simulated.
parserCorrection: The initial 12-case harness incorrectly modeled the platform parseResult as supporting ClipData. This harness extracts the official AwContentsClient.parseFileChooserResult implementation at pinned Chromium revision 586f39ce10f91f06192b790e0c7f8c019ce3306f, which reads only Intent.getData(). Earlier cases only establish the callback control flow they actually exercise.
